answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 28524 Country: United States of America Title: Is it ok for me to pray in jamat with a non-mahram female if we are the only two musalaan? Question: As salamu aleikum wa rahmatullah wa barakatu. Is it ok for me to pray in jamat with a non-mahram female if we are the only two musalaan? Answer ID: 28524 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 54/54/M=1432) It is not right for you to perform salah together. A non-mahram woman should offer salah in her home. Also, she should observe purdah from you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
